scope: Randomized variants of the buffs other players cast on the player on cooldown and of two Warrior spells that Rust refused before. Innervate (individualBuffs.innervates) and Mana Tide Totem (partyBuffs.manaTideTotems) for 19 requests of every class and spec: the Balance and Feral Druid, the Shadow and Smite Priest, the Fire and Frost Mage, the Destruction, Affliction and Demonology Warlock, the Marksmanship, Beast Mastery and Survival Hunter, the Retribution, Holy and Shockadin Paladin, the Elemental and Enhancement Shaman, the Fury Warrior and the Combat Rogue, the last two without mana, each with 1, 2 and 3 sources and 6 variants per effect, half of the Innervate variants without mana consumables, Wisdom or Mana Spring Totem and all of them at least 5 minutes long; an Elemental Shaman whose Mana Tide Totem talent adds a totem to its own party buffs; Taunt and Intimidating Shout cast by Protection, Arms, Fury Protection and Fury Warriors against 1, 2, 3 and 5 targets, tanking and not, at the first or another target, in Defensive Stance; and 23 accepted fixtures of the four mechanisms, 3 variants each. 356 variants of 74 requests at 200 iterations, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust. Each variant draws its race from the races of its class.
generator: python3 tools/external_cooldown_sweep.py --output <scratch>, which draws the variants of tools/sweep.py (seed 20261012 plus the row's position, 200 iterations, melee range for melee builds) from the accepted requests with the sources, the mana pressure and the taunts added to them; each variant <scratch>/NAME-sweep-NN.request.json is compared as variants/NAME-sweep-NN.request.json

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: Every variant matches the pinned Go engine on the whole result and the first-fight log. 123 of the 138 Innervate variants and all 141 Mana Tide Totem variants have the cooldown manager cast the buff in the first fight, and of the 53 variants that carry both Taunt and Intimidating Shout all cast Taunt and 52 the shout, as do the 24 variants of the 8 fixtures of the two spells. The sweep found two defects before it matched, both fixed with a fixture: Evocation did not move the baseline an Innervate's bonus mana is credited against, and Go's AddStatsDynamic leaves the raw MP5 a few ulps off its start once Mana Tide Totem expires (77 plus 483.33 minus 483.33 is 76.99999999999994), which decided whether a cost that just fits the mana is castable.
